voiceName.description: The served voice to speak in. A name no list holds is refused with the served voices named.

text.description: The words to say, as written. The engine derives how the voice says them.

emotion.description: One of the voice's emotions; the voice's own where absent.

language.description: The language the words are said in, `ko` or `en`; where absent, the one the words are in (English where more words hold a Latin letter than Hangul), else the voice's own.

path.description: The absolute path of the file to write. Its folders are made where they do not stand, and a file already there is replaced. Under the temporary folder where absent.
